trades.reasoning: CTSH is the only candidate showing all four confirmation signals — MACD bullish crossover, RSI 65.1 in the bullish zone, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge — indicating genuine buying interest even on an otherwise neutral day.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.3%), giving no strong risk-on or risk-off signal. Rather than idling cash or exiting existing winners, we added one high-conviction position in CTSH, the single name with full multi-signal confirmation, and left the other 7 holdings untouched.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.2% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, consistent with a quiet, low-catalyst trading session rather than any major news event. Without a clear economic surprise or earnings shock to drive flows, trading volume and conviction stayed muted across most sectors. Days like this are typically consolidation periods where the market digests recent moves before its next directional push.
market_education.summary_zh: 大市今日略為走軟，納指下跌0.2%，標普500指數下跌0.3%，反映市場缺乏明顯刺激因素，交投清淡。由於沒有重大經濟數據或業績意外帶動資金流向，多數板塊的買賣意欲均顯得保守。這類日子通常屬於市場消化先前升跌、等待下一個方向性走勢的整固階段。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of acting on a single bullish clue, disciplined investors wait for several signals — like a MACD crossover, a healthy (not overbought) RSI, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to line up together. When multiple independent signals agree, it lowers the chance of a false alarm and gives more confidence that real buying interest, not noise, is driving the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 有紀律的投資者不會單憑一個利好訊號就行動，而是等待多個訊號同時出現，例如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康（非超買）區間、股價高於其移動平均線，以及成交量放大。當多個獨立訊號一致時，可大幅降低假訊號的機會，亦更能確認背後是真實買盤，而非市場雜訊。
